title: a16z Podcast: Selling to Developers & Open Source Business Models

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: Developers are more than just influencers inside the enterprise -- they're now buyers, too.
reader_summary.overview: Developers are more than just influencers inside the enterprise -- they're now buyers, too. That's a huge shift from before, when only IT and other departments had that kind of purchasing power. (It's not just a Silicon Valley thing, either, as every company becomes a software company.) So what's different then about selling and marketing to developers?

key_points.text: But offering products and services built on top of open source brings up a whole slew of other questions: What are viable business models.
